Name: Animals Need Water
Author: gzhynko
Description:
[b]Animals Need Water[/b] brings life to the water troughs your animal houses have. Animals will now consume water in them, making you need to refill them daily. You receive friendship points with each animal in a building with a watered trough at the end of the day. Not refilling the troughs makes your animals thirsty, reducing your friendship with them. If you water the trough with animals inside the building, you'll receive some additional friendship points with each of them, and they'll show a little "love" bubble. Animals that are still thirsty later in the day will periodically show a sad emote to remind you (by default after 3 PM). The number of friendship points in each case, the emote start time, and these notifications can all be configured.

Some buildings, like the deluxe versions of the barn and the coop, now come with a watering system that waters the troughs automatically each morning. This behavior can be configured with the
[code]﻿UseWateringSystems[/code]parameter. Note that you are unable to receive the additional friendship points with the animals inside a building with a watering system.
Animals can also drink water outside if they are able to reach the closest water body, well, trough, etc. (can be configured). If the animal was able to drink outside, but its water trough was left empty, it will not be counted as left thirsty yesterday.

Marnie now also has water bowls in stock for free (a government subsidy)! Whenever you have a building that does not have a trough profile (i.e. no troughs, or the pre-installed troughs do not work), get one of these, place it inside the building, and it will work the same as normal troughs. Sprinklers placed next to a bowl will even top it up for you each morning. Both the water bowl's price and whether Marnie stocks it are configurable.

All options can be edited in the config file, or in-game (no restart required) with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

  Animals Need Water will automatically detect these and load the corresponding trough placement profiles. Besides the above, any building, interior, or recolor mod can be made compatible by shipping a small Content Patcher pack. See For mod creators below for more on this.

  When a building's trough is empty, ANW draws a small overlay on the building's exterior (vanilla coops). You can turn this off with the
[code]ChangeBuildingTextureIfTroughIsEmpty[/code]option, and exterior retexture packs can supply their own matching overlay via that same Content Patcher pack.

  If you want an even more immersive experience (such as animal dehydration), consider checking out the [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7769]Animals Die[/url] mod.

[size=4]For mod creators[/size]
  Animals Need Water is built to be extended via the content pipeline - with Content Patcher, for example. You can:
[list]
[*]Add trough placement profiles for custom or retextured buildings, [/*]
[*]Provide your own trough and watering-system sprites, [/*]
[*]Add or change exterior overlays,[/*]
[*]Customize water-related animal behavior, and[/*]
[*]Add custom indoor water sources for animals to drink from.[/*]
[/list]  See the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/AnimalsNeedWater/docs/author-guide.md]author guide[/url] for more info on this.
  It also provides an API which allows you to access some of the mod's data at runtime. See the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/AnimalsNeedWater/docs/API-documentation.md]API Documentation[/url] for more info.
